{{Quote|The Emperor's words make everything clear, Jedi. The First Son will prevail, and you will die.|Saiak|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Saiak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] who was serving on the [[Corellian Council]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. However, Saiak was also a [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] agent of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], and Saiak revealed his true nature when the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] stormed [[Guardian Hold One]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Jedi, please understand. We can all agree these consequences are unfortunate. But some of us were buying time. The Empire's offer was a chance to save Corellia, and her people.|Saiak talking with Barsen'thor|<ref name="TOR" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Saiak was present in [[Guardian Hold One]] where he acted as a member of the [[Corellian Council]]. Along with Councilors [[Delquis]] and [[Nadien]], Saiak secretly planned to have them negotiate with the [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]] to allow Corellia to join the Empire. However, the plan failed when [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] arrived to search for the First Son. Eventually, Saiak revealed himself as a Child of the Emperor and killed Delquis for failing. Saiak couldn't allow the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to hunt down the First Son and engages him in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] combat. The [[Jedi Consular]] took the upper hand and defeated Saiak. During the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|final confrontation]] with Tenebrae, Saiak was among the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] witnessing his final [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=General|Echoes of Oblivion|Kira Carsen's ship}}</ref>
